bullets: Full design and ownership of the AWS architecture: ECS Fargate, ECR, ElastiCache Redis, S3 + CloudFront for frontends, Secrets Manager, and GPU instances for Hugging Face models.
Implemented the CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions: main branch → pre-production, v* tags → production with manual approval, managing 10 ECS services across 4 repositories.
Backend in FastAPI: HTTP logging middleware with UUID traceability, structured logging with structlog, custom domain error system, rate limiting and validation handlers.
Built integrations with Slack, Microsoft Teams, and WhatsApp Business for the conversational agent.
Designed the RAG pipeline (ai_core): embeddings, retrieval, and prompt construction with Ollama on AWS, evolving toward function calling via Anthropic API and routing through Amazon Bedrock.
Developed a FastAPI API integrating with a time-tracking platform with 300,000+ users: authentication, roles, KPIs, security, and deployment.
Main developer of the full Angular + TypeScript dashboard: feature implementation, user flows, and business logic.
DevOps: containerization with Docker Compose and Nginx configuration on the production server.
Agile environment with Scrum/Kanban, pull requests, and code reviews.
